title: JetDiffusion: Pushing the Speed Limits of Video Generation with NVFP4 Sparse Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.33268v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attention over long sequences is a major computational bottleneck in video generation, which can be alleviated through sparsity and low-bit quantization. We propose JetDiffusion, a video generation system built on trainable Video Sparse Quantized Attention (VSQA), with custom inference kernels that combine native NVFP4 computation and kernel fusion. At 90% sparsity, VSQA accelerates attention by 8-29x compared with FlashAttention on different hardwares. To further accelerate video generation, we combine VSQA with NVFP4 linear quantization and step distillation. Although each technique can individually preserve generation quality, jointly adapting to all three remains challenging, particularly under aggressive NVFP4 quantization. Through empirical studies, we develop an effective staged training recipe that enables stable adaptation to quantization, sparsity, and few-step denoising. translated_title: JetDiffusion：利用NVFP4稀疏注意力突破视频生成的速度极限
translated_abstract: 长序列注意力是视频生成中的主要计算瓶颈，可以通过稀疏化和低比特量化来缓解。我们提出了JetDiffusion，一个建立在可训练视频稀疏量化注意力（VSQA）之上的视频生成系统，配备结合原生NVFP4计算与核融合的自定义推理内核。在90%稀疏度下，VSQA在不同硬件上相比FlashAttention可将注意力加速8-29倍。为进一步加速视频生成，我们将VSQA与NVFP4线性量化和步数蒸馏相结合。尽管每项技术单独使用均能保持生成质量，但联合适应这三种技术仍然充满挑战，尤其是在激进的NVFP4量化条件下。通过实证研究，我们开发出一种有效的分阶段训练方案，能够稳定地适应量化、稀疏化和少步去噪。在Wan2.1-14B上，所得模型实现了273倍端到端加速。
tldr: JetDiffusion通过可训练的视频稀疏量化注意力（VSQA）结合NVFP4量化、核融合与步数蒸馏，并借助分阶段训练方案稳定适应三项加速技术，实现了注意力8-29倍加速和端到端273倍加速的视频生成系统。
en_tdlr: JetDiffusion achieves 8-29x attention speedup and 273x end-to-end acceleration in video generation by combining trainable Video Sparse Quantized Attention (VSQA) with NVFP4 quantization, kernel fusion, and step distillation, enabled by an effective staged training recipe.
